overview: Roadie Roster is a store roadie onboarding and roster app with a demo mode for safe rehearsals.
features: Admin-only Demo mode switch with DEMO confirmation and 8-hour auto-off
Sticky orange demo banner on every screen with Turn off, View as and Pretend it's controls
Strict separation of demo records from real records across roadies, sign-ups, crews, leaders, check-ins and notes
View as role picker that enforces the chosen role's permissions against demo data
Load and clear demo data with about 40 roadies, crews, leaders and pending sign-ups
Pretend date that overrides now for schedules, countdowns, the Today screen, check-in availability and age math
Sign as Test button on signature pads in demo mode
Kiosk sign-ups saved as demo sign-ups in demo mode
